title: Psychedelic Wanderer
description: A surreal black and white line drawing with blue and purple accents depicts a three-eyed humanoid creature with a wide grin, pointed ears, and a backpack featuring an eyeball. It walks across a dark landscape holding a staff with a 'TRIPS' flag while leaving footprints, with a large crystal ball containing a figure and celestial symbols floating above mountains in the background.
